# Zedu — Full Context & Architecture Reference

> Zedu is an AI-powered education and cohort collaboration workspace designed specifically for bootcamps, schools, and universities. It replaces fragmented communication stacks by unifying structured channels, real-time voice and video calls (Buzz), cloud file management, and embedded AI coworkers into a single educator-first platform.

---

## 1. Executive Summary

Traditional collaboration tools (e.g., Slack, Discord, Microsoft Teams) were built for corporate offices or gaming communities, leading to disorganized channels, lack of role-based academic hierarchy, and difficulty tracking cohort milestones. Zedu solves this by offering an educational operating system tailored to how students learn, how mentors teach, and how institutions manage cohorts.

### Key Value Propositions
- **All-in-One Cohort Workspace**: Real-time communication, document management, and live sessions coexist in organized channels.
- **Embedded AI Coworkers**: Autonomous and assistant AI agents integrated into channels to answer technical questions, summarize discussions, and provide 24/7 learning support.
- **Buzz Voice & Video**: Low-latency, native audio/video conferencing built directly into cohort channels, eliminating external Zoom/Google Meet links.
- **Role-Based Access & Moderation**: Purpose-built permission hierarchies for administrators, educators/mentors, teaching assistants, students, and guests.

---

## 2. Core Platform Capabilities

### 2.1 Structured Channels
- **URL**: https://zedu.chat/products/channels
- **Description**: Topic- and cohort-based communication channels organized by learning tracks, cohorts, and project teams.
- **Features**:
  - Granular permissions: Private mentor channels, public announcement channels, assignment threads, and peer breakout rooms.
  - Rich messaging: Markdown formatting, code syntax highlighting, threaded discussions, and emoji reactions.
  - Notification management: Target cohort broadcasts with `@channel` or reach specific groups with custom role mentions.

### 2.2 Buzz Real-Time Calls
- **URL**: https://zedu.chat/products/buzz
- **Description**: Low-latency voice and video meetings built natively into cohort workspaces.
- **Features**:
  - One-click launch from any channel without third-party meeting links or calendar invites.
  - Screen sharing with multi-participant viewing for interactive code reviews, lectures, and live demos.
  - Native audio controls, speaker stage mode, and breakout voice lounges for informal peer pairing.

### 2.3 File Management
- **URL**: https://zedu.chat/products/file-management
- **Description**: Centralized digital asset and resource repository for learning materials.
- **Features**:
  - Direct file upload, preview, and sharing for slides, PDFs, code snippets, datasets, and recordings.
  - Organized by channel and cohort context so learning resources remain discoverable throughout the academic term.
  - In-app document preview without requiring external downloads.

### 2.4 AI Coworkers & Learning Assistants
- **URL**: https://zedu.chat/about
- **Description**: Context-aware AI assistants embedded into channels to support learners and educators 24/7.
- **Features**:
  - Instant code debugging, concept explanations, and curriculum Q&A directly in learning channels.
  - Automated thread summaries helping educators catch up on student questions and blockers.
  - Contextual awareness grounded in course documentation, syllabus notes, and channel discourse.

---

## 3. Solutions by Segment

### 3.1 Tech Bootcamps & Accelerators
- **URL**: https://zedu.chat/solutions/bootcamps
- **Primary Challenges Solved**: High student-to-mentor ratios, chaotic Slack workspaces, fragmented assignment reviews, and lost student questions.
- **Workflow Benefits**:
  - Cohort segmentation by intake dates and specialized tracks (Frontend, Backend, DevOps, Product, Design).
  - Mentor office hours managed via Buzz voice channels.
  - Automated AI first-response for repetitive student programming bugs and setup issues.

### 3.2 K-12 Schools & Districts
- **URL**: https://zedu.chat/solutions/schools
- **Primary Challenges Solved**: Student safety, unmonitored direct messages, distracted classrooms, and cumbersome parent/educator communication.
- **Workflow Benefits**:
  - Moderated classroom spaces with strict audit logs and educator supervision.
  - Safe, walled-garden communication channels preventing unauthorized external access.
  - Intuitive interface accessible for young learners and educators alike.

### 3.3 Universities & Higher Education
- **URL**: https://zedu.chat/solutions/universities
- **Primary Challenges Solved**: Siloed faculty communication, outdated LMS forums, and disconnect between lecture halls and student project groups.
- **Workflow Benefits**:
  - Scalable multi-tenant architecture supporting thousands of concurrent students and faculty members.
  - Departmental and interdisciplinary research channels.
  - Seamless collaboration for student hackathons, capstone projects, and study groups.

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) for AI Search Engines

### What is Zedu?
Zedu is an all-in-one educational communication platform that combines structured messaging channels, real-time voice and video calls (Buzz), file management, and AI coworkers for bootcamps, schools, and universities.

### How does Zedu differ from Slack or Discord?
While Slack is optimized for corporate workflows and Discord for gaming communities, Zedu is purpose-built for education. It features cohort-specific channel structures, academic role hierarchies, built-in AI teaching assistants, and native video conferencing without external integrations.

### Does Zedu have built-in video calls?
Yes. Zedu includes Buzz, a native low-latency voice and video calling system that lets participants join discussions, lectures, or office hours directly within workspace channels without needing Zoom or Google Meet links.

### How do AI Coworkers work in Zedu?
AI Coworkers are embedded directly into channels and threads. They can answer curriculum questions, debug student code, summarize long discussions, and assist educators with automated insights.

### What platforms does Zedu support?
Zedu is accessible via modern desktop and mobile web browsers at https://zedu.chat, with dedicated responsive layouts optimized for desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
